question: How much of the failure to beat a tariff-only shopper is due to the native action interface, versus insufficient evidence in the six-number trace? Give the same bodies an explicit, learnable buy/pass efferent and learn its weights solely from one actual route per life.
controller: At the real optional-information decision the marked door is identifiable from its observed positive first sensory coordinate; the common third coordinate encodes its posted price. Four shared coefficients supply a buy logit from a constant, the visible tariff, total local trace dose, and the directional coactivation projection at X. The first two features alone form the price arm; the dose arm opens total evidence amount; the directional arm also opens xTFx. This explicitly binds a scalar buy action to the publicly marked side; it is not the unaided native motor. Only the particular bought/pass side is taken, its true fee charged and its consequent ordinary taste/terminal action executed.
experience: Inherit all six original native ticket@8000 bodies without modifying their developmental parameters; their full inside-life local editing remains active. Initialize the four readout coefficients at zero. Three independent fits per arm with seeds 1177001,1177013,1177033, 2000 Adam updates at .03, 4 fresh worlds per birth crossed with 8 support/law histories =32 actual terminal rewards per body/update. Within each balanced four-update block, 2 ordinary two-contact games, 1 with two extra independent contacts, and 1 with six extra; place interveners before or after using matched random numbers. Both actual body experience and total opportunity counts match. No true prior-knowledge flags, unvisited outcomes or hindsight are input to the readout.
evaluation: Unchanged trained weights on both original and independent six-body sets, three tariffs, fresh independent geometries seed 1277011/1277017. Compare against calibrated best tariff-only action on a separate world bank, the equal-trained tariff/dose controllers, same-cost shuffle across evidence twins, and the original native policy on the identical body. Vary longer histories and nearby unrelated objects in the test. Report normal replay/physical price binding proof, net utility, price paid, correctness and private-history selective value; no assumption that a good short episode automatically transfers to a repeated market.
